quote: 1. Never invest in a business you cannot understand.

quote: 2. A lot of people with high IQs are terrible investors because they've got terrible temperaments.

quote: 3. The riskiest thing in the world is the belief that there is no risk.

quote: 87. Risk means more things can happen than will happen.
